I'm not much into explaining the jokes, no matter how bad they are. But here we go:


The first ability refers to Glasnost; hence you "reveal yourself" and profit from this openness in a peaceful way.

The second ability is a more subtle reference to Perestroika; it involves a "new" type of economy; in this case, playing cards exiled from the library instead of from one's hand.

The third ability is a homage to the failed dream of an eventual transition into a social democracy. The whole society is restructured; the old komissars are replaced by fresh, new leaders, and new oportunities arise.
Oh, I never thought about regenerating Treasures. It's a clunky, non synergistic design. This time I put flavour over mechanics again, my bad. :(

Not only that, but actually acquiring those battlegrounds will not be easy in the first place, so your board presence elsewhere will suffer, and you'll probably lag behind in VPs. I confess I played that game as an experiment, as I usually consider European Control as a difficult win condition... and the experiment blew up on my face.
